name: 鱼药休药期与温度校正器

map.按实际水温校正鱼药休药期（度日模型），保障水产品食用安全: Compute the drug withdrawal period with temperature correction for fish.
map.📖 查看「鱼药休药期温度校正（度日模型）使用指南」: 📖 View the "Fish Drug Withdrawal Temperature Correction (Degree-Day Model) Guide"
map.采用度日(degree-day)模型：消除所需度日 K=标准天数×(参考温度-温: A degree-day model is used: the degree-days needed for elimination K = standard days × (reference temperature - lower temperature limit); corrected days = K ÷ (actual water temperature - lower temperature limit). The higher the water temperature, the faster the metabolism and the shorter the withdrawal period; below the limit the drug is metabolised very slowly, so extend the period and strengthen testing.
map.📚 深度解析：鱼药休药期温度校正（度日模型）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Fish Drug Withdrawal Temperature Correction (Degree-Day Model)
map.出池上市前按实际水温校正休药期，确保渔药残留低于 MRL，避免药检不合格。: Before harvest and sale, correct the withdrawal period for the actual water temperature to keep drug residues below the MRL and avoid failing a drug test.
map.水温偏高时药物代谢快，可较标准休药期缩短；水温偏低（尤其接近温度下限）时大幅延长: Warmer water speeds up drug metabolism, so the period can be shorter than standard; colder water (especially near the lower limit) extends it greatly.
map.不同鱼药（恩诺沙星、土霉素、氟苯尼考、磺胺类、甲醛）按各自标准休药期与参考温度校: Different drugs (enrofloxacin, oxytetracycline, florfenicol, sulfonamides, formalin) are corrected with their own standard withdrawal period and reference temperature.
map.标准 14 天 @15℃ 在水温 22℃ 下的校正: Correcting a standard 14 days @15 ℃ at a water temperature of 22 ℃
map.默认参数（标准休药期 14 天 @ 参考温度 15℃、温度下限 5℃、实际水温: With the default parameters (standard withdrawal period 14 days @ a reference temperature of 15 ℃, lower temperature limit 5 ℃, actual water temperature 22 ℃): the degree-day requirement K = 14×(15−5) = 140 ℃·days; the effective temperature = 22−5 = 17 ℃; the corrected withdrawal period = 140 / 17 ≈ 8.2 days, about 0.59 times the standard, shortened by the warmer water. If the water temperature falls to 8 ℃, the corrected value = 140/3 ≈ 46.7 days, markedly longer.
map.度日（℃·天）衡量累积温度对药物代谢的驱动，休药期随有效温度成反比，是水产药残控: A degree-day (℃·day) measures the driving effect of accumulated temperature on drug metabolism; the withdrawal period is inversely proportional to the effective temperature, a common simplified model for drug-residue control in aquaculture.
map.水温低于下限怎么办？: What if the water temperature is below the limit?
map.有效温度 ≤0 时代谢极慢，工具会提示延长休药期并建议送样检测残留，不可直接套用: When the effective temperature is ≤0 the metabolism is extremely slow; the tool warns you to extend the withdrawal period and send samples for residue testing, and the formula must not be applied directly.
map.鱼药休药期与温度校正器 - 基于度日模型按水温校正鱼药休药期，渔业水产在线工具。: Fish Drug Withdrawal Calculator - corrects the fish drug withdrawal period for water temperature based on a degree-day model, an online fishery and aquaculture tool. A fishery and aquaculture tool that helps calculate farming parameters and yields.
